exact_target.domain: q:Nat→Nat, L:Nat, FoldedDecimal.Admissible L q; c=0 or c=18; write (L_j,q_j)=OverflowCarryNormalization.iterPairs q L j.
exact_target.birth_definition: BornRun q L c a b := RunAncestry.MaximalRun (FoldedDecimal.nextColumns q L) (FoldedDecimal.nextWidth q L) c a b ∧ ∀i, a≤i → i<b → L≤i ∨ q i≠c.
exact_target.one_step_partition: Under Admissible L q and c=0∨c=18, every next-word MaximalRun[a,b) is either BornRun q L c a b, OR has a unique old interval(u,v) with MaximalRun q L c u v and descendant q L c u v=(a,b). The alternatives are exclusive.
exact_target.founder_coverage: Every maximal c-run[a,b) at time t has a unique triple(r,u,v),0≤r≤t: [u,v) is a maximal run at time r, either r=0 or(r>0 and BornRun q_(r-1) L_(r-1) c u v), and track q_r L_r c u v (t-r)=(a,b). Uniqueness is for the founder time and maximal interval, never for one position in it.
exact_target.finite_theorem: For Admissible L q, R,t:Nat, (∀a b,MaximalRun q L c a b→b-a≤R), no BornRun at any transition j<t, and4*R+1≤t: ∀i<L_t,q_t i≠c. Apply the same statement to state_s to obtain a window[s,s+t).
exact_target.tail_equivalence: (∃S,∀s≥S,∀a b,¬BornRun q_s L_s c a b) ↔ (∃T,∀t≥T,∀i<L_t,q_t i≠c). Equivalently, c occurs arbitrarily late iff c-birth transitions occur arbitrarily late.
exact_target.both_extremes: Apply the fixed-c statements separately to c=0 and c=18; a common finite start/deadline follows by max. Do not reinterpret MaximalRun as an alternating0/18 block.
exact_target.orbit_corollary: Retain Canonical n d L and q=columnSum d L on the physical prefix, then use iterPairs_representation for the unchanged ordinary Lychrel196.orbit. The map continues after palindromes; no conclusion that any particular orbit satisfies eventual birth-freedom is asserted.
exact_target.local_pattern_connection: Prove that existence of a physical BornRun is equivalent to an existing actual fresh-extreme site, using Agent106.NoOverflowBirths.fresh_zero_iff/fresh_eighteen_iff in the no-overflow branch and RunBirths.Overflow.new_zero_iff/new_eighteen_iff in the overflow branch. The latter site definition excludes an old homogeneous adjacent pair; its exact classifier implies neither old adjacent coefficient equals the new extreme. Overflow endpoints cannot be extreme by next_endpoints_not_extreme.
exact_target.timestamp_convention: BornRun q_s L_s describes a transition at s whose founder run first appears in state s+1. A founder state time r>0 therefore uses BornRun at transition r-1.
exact_target.uniqueness_limit: The founder maximal RUN and state time are unique; a newly born run can contain multiple newborn positions.

checked_semantic_basis: descendant_step gives exact next-word membership on the old run interval.
Every nonempty descendant is maximal in the whole next word and lies inside its old interval; this prior theorem is reused unchanged.
An old physical extreme position lying in a current maximal run belongs to an old maximal run; the corresponding nonempty descendant and current run overlap and hence agree.
Distinct old maximal runs cannot share a nonempty descendant, since containment would make the old runs overlap. No independent no-merging hypothesis is assumed.
BornRun uses the physical guard L≤i ∨ q i≠c; Admissible imposes no constraint on function values outside the old width.
The existing extinct_uniform supplies 4*ell+1 for each founder; the new obligation is complete coverage of all current runs.
Restarting at an eventual no-birth time and taking R equal to that state width suffices for eventual absence, without a uniform bound over all time.
PopulationGrowth and PopulationObstructions prevent replacing the birth-free hypothesis by unrestricted population monotonicity.
